name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck kitchen orders
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect your kitchen from too many orders, and keep serving even when the mobile signal goes. Ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is an ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can make, then mark them ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can make at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queue fits the kitchen.

ORDER TAKING AT THE COUNTER
Take on-the-spot orders on the same screen where orders placed ahead also appear, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen display shows what to make now, what's next and what's ready, and warns you when an order needs to be started.

ORDER TICKET PRINTING
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

SERVING EVEN WHEN THE SIGNAL GOES
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection drops, pre-ordering pauses, so nobody places an order you can't see. Orders taken on the device are kept and sync when you are back online.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get notified when an order is waiting for confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once, then take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is made for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
